# feature engineering

```{python regulatory-category}
pat_commercial = r"(?i)hotel|hostel|bed and breakfast|\bresort\b"
pl.col("property_type").str.contains(pat_commercial)

pat_primary = r"(?i)apartment|condominium|condo|\bloft\b|serviced|rental unit|residential|entire home|entire place|\bfloor\b"
pl.col("property_type").str.contains(pat_primary)


def add_regulatory_features(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .with_columns([
            pl.when(
                (pl.col("room_type") == "Hotel room") |
                pl.col("property_type").str.contains(pat_commercial)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("commercial_type"))
            .when(
                (pl.col("room_type") == "Entire home/apt") &
                pl.col("property_type").str.contains(pat_primary)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("entire_primary_likely"))
            .when(pl.col("room_type") == "Entire home/apt")
            .then(pl.lit("entire_nonstandard"))
            .when(pl.col("room_type").is_in(["Private room", "Shared room"]))
            .then(pl.lit("room_rental"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("other"))
            .cast(pl.Categorical)
            .alias("regulatory_category"),
        ])
        .with_columns([
            (
                (pl.col("regulatory_category") == "entire_primary_likely") &
                (pl.col("minimum_nights") >= 30)
            ).alias("min_nights_avoidance_flag"),

            pl.when(
                (pl.col("regulatory_category") == "entire_primary_likely") &
                (pl.col("maximum_nights") == 365)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("cap_365"))
            .when(
                (pl.col("regulatory_category") == "entire_primary_likely") &
                (pl.col("maximum_nights") == 1125)
            )
            .then(pl.lit("no_max_set"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("other"))
            .cast(pl.Enum(["other", "cap_365", "no_max_set"]))
            .alias("max_nights_risk_flag"),
        ])
    )

train_clean = add_regulatory_features(train_clean)
test_clean = add_regulatory_features(test_clean)
```

```{python amenities-parsing}
from functools import reduce

# Keywords per semantic bucket - each keyword contributes 1 to the bucket count
_LUXURY_KW   = [r"\bpool\b", r"hot tub", r"jacuzzi", r"sauna", r"\bgym\b", r"fitness center",
                r"doorman", r"fireplace", r"piano", r"billiard", r"game room", r"concierge"]
_PRACTICAL_KW = [r"wifi", r"internet", r"wireless", r"kitchen", r"\bwasher\b", r"\bdryer\b",
                 r"\bheating\b", r"air conditioning", r"refrigerator", r"microwave",
                 r"dishwasher", r"\biron\b", r"hair dryer", r"coffee maker"]
def _bucket_count(am_expr, keywords: list) -> pl.Expr:
    flags = [am_expr.str.contains(kw).cast(pl.Int32) for kw in keywords]
    return reduce(lambda a, b: a + b, flags)

def parse_amenities(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    am = pl.col("amenities").fill_null("").str.to_lowercase()
    return df.with_columns([
        _bucket_count(am, _LUXURY_KW).alias("amenity_luxury_count"),
        _bucket_count(am, _PRACTICAL_KW).alias("amenity_practical_count"),
    ])

train_clean = parse_amenities(train_clean)
test_clean  = parse_amenities(test_clean)
```

```{python host-quality-signals}
def host_quality(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        (pl.col("host_total_listings_count").is_not_null() & (pl.col("host_total_listings_count") > 1))
            .cast(pl.Int32).alias("is_multi_listing_host"),
        pl.when(pl.col("host_about").is_null())
            .then(0)
            .otherwise(pl.col("host_about").str.split(" ").list.len())
            .cast(pl.Float64).alias("host_experience_proxy"),
        # encode response_time ordinal (faster = higher score) then add response_rate
        # host_response_time is Categorical - cast to Utf8 before replacing
        (
            pl.col("host_response_rate").fill_null(0) +
            pl.col("host_response_time").cast(pl.Utf8)
              .replace({"within an hour": "25", "within a few hours": "15", "within a day": "5", "a few days or more": "0"})
              .fill_null("0")
              .cast(pl.Float64)
        ).alias("response_score"),
        # host_is_superhost is Categorical ("t"/"f") - cast to numeric before multiplying
        (
            pl.col("host_is_superhost").cast(pl.Utf8).str.contains("t").cast(pl.Float64) *
            pl.col("host_response_rate").fill_null(0)
        ).alias("host_reliability"),
        # host_has_profile_picture
        pl.col("host_picture_url").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("host_has_profile_picture"),
        # lower numeric user ID = older/more established account - log-scaled to prevent ID memorization
        pl.col("host_picture_url")
            .str.extract(r"/users/(\d+)/", 1)
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .log(base=10)
            .alias("host_account_age_proxy"),
        # unix timestamp of profile pic upload - log-scaled to prevent memorization
        pl.col("host_picture_url")
            .str.extract(r"/profile_pic/(\d+)/", 1)
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .log(base=10)
            .alias("host_photo_timestamp"),
        # legacy URL format = established older account vs newer UUID-based profile URLs
        pl.col("host_picture_url")
            .str.contains(r"/users/\d+/profile_pic/")
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("host_is_legacy_url"),

    ])

train_clean = host_quality(train_clean)
test_clean  = host_quality(test_clean)
```

```{python complete-listings}
def add_complete_listings(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        (
            pl.col("accommodates").is_not_null() & (pl.col("accommodates") > 0) &
            pl.col("bathrooms").is_not_null() & (pl.col("bathrooms") > 0) &
            pl.col("bedrooms").is_not_null() & (pl.col("bedrooms") > 0) &
            pl.col("beds").is_not_null() & (pl.col("beds") > 0) &
            pl.col("bed_type").is_not_null() & (pl.col("bed_type").cast(pl.Utf8) != "N/A") &
            pl.col("property_type").is_not_null() & (pl.col("property_type") != "N/A") & (pl.col("property_type") != "") &
            pl.col("room_type").is_not_null() & (pl.col("room_type") != "N/A") & (pl.col("room_type") != "") &
            pl.col("cancellation_policy").is_not_null() & (pl.col("cancellation_policy").cast(pl.Utf8) != "N/A") & (pl.col("cancellation_policy").cast(pl.Utf8) != "") &
            pl.col("amenities").is_not_null() & (pl.col("amenities") != "") & (pl.col("amenities") != "0") &
            pl.col("host_response_time").is_not_null() &
            pl.col("host_response_rate").is_not_null() &
            pl.col("name").is_not_null() & (pl.col("name") != "") &
            pl.col("description").is_not_null() & (pl.col("description") != "")
        ).cast(pl.Int32).alias("complete_listings")
    ])

train_clean = add_complete_listings(train_clean)
test_clean  = add_complete_listings(test_clean)

train_clean["complete_listings"].value_counts()
```

```{python impute-values}
test_clean  = test_clean.with_columns(pl.col("guests_included").fill_null(1))

)

        .otherwise(pl.col("beds")).alias("beds")
)

# bedrooms - NA = studio = 0

test_clean  = test_clean.with_columns(pl.col("bedrooms").fill_null(0).cast(pl.Int32))

# remove bedroom outliers from train; cap test

test_clean  = test_clean.with_columns(pl.col("bedrooms").clip(upper_bound=10))

# extra_people, security_deposit, cleaning_fee - impute 0
for col in ["extra_people", "security_deposit", "cleaning_fee"]:
    train_clean = train_clean.with_columns(pl.col(col).fill_null(0))

# review sub-score imputation - impute 10 where p25 == 10
review_sub_cols = [
    "review_scores_accuracy", "review_scores_cleanliness",
    "review_scores_checkin",  "review_scores_communication",
    "review_scores_location",  "review_scores_value"
]

p25_vals = {col: train_clean[col].quantile(0.25) for col in review_sub_cols}
print(p25_vals)

for col, p25 in p25_vals.items():
    if p25 == 10:
        for df_name, df in [("train", train_clean), ("test", test_clean)]:
            updated = df.with_columns(
                pl.when((pl.col("has_reviews") == 1) & pl.col(col).is_null())
                    .then(10.0).otherwise(pl.col(col)).alias(col)
            )
            if df_name == "train":
                train_clean = updated
            else:
                test_clean = updated

# categorize review sub-scores: 0 = no reviews, 1 = <10, 2 = ==10
def cat_review_expr(col_name: str) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        pl.when((pl.col("has_reviews") == 0) | pl.col(col_name).is_null())
            .then(0)
            .when(pl.col(col_name) < 10)
            .then(1)
            .otherwise(2)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias(col_name)
    )

train_clean = train_clean.with_columns([cat_review_expr(c) for c in review_sub_cols])
test_clean  = test_clean.with_columns([cat_review_expr(c) for c in review_sub_cols])
```

```{python host-response-imputation}
# empirical means from non-null train rows, grouped by recoded comm score (0/1/2)
_COMM_IMPUTE = {0: 90.0, 1: 95.0, 2: 96.0}

def impute_and_bucket_response_rate(df: pl.DataFrame, comm_map: dict = _COMM_IMPUTE) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        df
        .with_columns([
            pl.col("host_response_rate").is_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("host_response_rate_missing"),
            pl.when(pl.col("host_response_rate").is_not_null())
                .then(pl.col("host_response_rate"))
                .when(pl.col("host_is_superhost").cast(pl.Utf8) == "TRUE")
                .then(pl.lit(98.0))
                .when(pl.col("review_scores_communication") == 0)
                .then(pl.lit(comm_map[0]))
                .when(pl.col("review_scores_communication") == 1)
                .then(pl.lit(comm_map[1]))
                .otherwise(pl.lit(comm_map[2]))
                .alias("host_response_rate"),
        ])
        .with_columns(
            pl.when(pl.col("host_response_rate") >= 100)
                .then(pl.lit("perfect"))
                .when(pl.col("host_response_rate") >= 90)
                .then(pl.lit("near_perfect"))
                .otherwise(pl.lit("underperforming"))
                .cast(pl.Categorical)
                .alias("host_response_tier")
        )
    )

train_clean = impute_and_bucket_response_rate(train_clean)
test_clean  = impute_and_bucket_response_rate(test_clean)

print("Response tier distribution (train):")
print(train_clean["host_response_tier"].value_counts(sort=True))
print("\nMissing flag:")
print(train_clean["host_response_rate_missing"].value_counts())
```

```{python host-acceptance-imputation}
print("\n=== Mean acceptance rate by superhost (non-null rows) ===")

print("\n=== Booking rate: null vs non-null acceptance rate ===")
print(train_clean.with_columns(

# --- imputation (update constants from diagnostic output above) ---
_ACC_SUPERHOST_MEAN = 91.9   # empirical mean of non-null superhost rows
_ACC_OTHER_MEAN     = 84.3   # empirical mean of non-null non-superhost rows

def impute_acceptance_rate(df: pl.DataFrame,
                           superhost_mean: float = _ACC_SUPERHOST_MEAN,
                           other_mean: float = _ACC_OTHER_MEAN) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.col("host_acceptance_rate").is_null().cast(pl.Int32)
          .alias("host_acceptance_rate_missing"),
        pl.when(pl.col("host_acceptance_rate").is_not_null())
          .then(pl.col("host_acceptance_rate"))
          .when(
              pl.col("instant_bookable").cast(pl.Utf8).str.to_lowercase()
                .str.contains("t")
          )
          .then(pl.lit(100.0))
          .when(pl.col("host_is_superhost").cast(pl.Utf8) == "TRUE")
          .then(pl.lit(superhost_mean))
          .otherwise(pl.lit(other_mean))
          .alias("host_acceptance_rate"),
    ])

train_clean = impute_acceptance_rate(train_clean)
```

```{python pricing-signals}
# shrinkage only to sparse neighbourhoods
LAMBDA = 30  # shrinkage strength; tune between 10–50

_global_median_price: float = float(train_clean["price"].median())

_nbhd_agg = (
    train_clean
    .group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed")
    .agg([
        pl.col("price").median().alias("raw_median"),
        pl.col("price").count().alias("n")
    ])
    .with_columns([
        ((pl.col("n") * pl.col("raw_median") + LAMBDA * _global_median_price)
         / (pl.col("n") + LAMBDA))
            .alias("smoothed_median")
    ])
)

_nbhd_median = dict(zip(
    _nbhd_agg["neighbourhood_cleansed"].to_list(),
    _nbhd_agg["smoothed_median"].to_list()
))

# OOF smoothed target encoding for neighbourhood booking rate
# Each training row's rate is computed from the other 4 folds only - no leakage.
# Test rows use the full-training smoothed rate (safe: test labels are unknown).
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

K_BOOKING = 200

_global_booking_rate = float(
    train_clean["high_booking"].cast(pl.Utf8).cast(pl.Int32).mean()
)

_nbhd_arr = train_clean["neighbourhood_cleansed"].cast(pl.Utf8).to_numpy()
_hb_arr   = train_clean["high_booking"].cast(pl.Utf8).cast(pl.Int32).to_numpy()
_n_train  = len(_nbhd_arr)
_oof_rate = np.full(_n_train, _global_booking_rate, dtype=float)

_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
for _tr_idx, _val_idx in _skf.split(np.zeros(_n_train), _hb_arr):
    _fold_df  = pd.DataFrame({"nbhd": _nbhd_arr[_tr_idx], "hb": _hb_arr[_tr_idx].astype(float)})
    _fold_agg = _fold_df.groupby("nbhd")["hb"].agg(["sum", "count"])
    _fold_agg["rate"] = (_fold_agg["sum"] + K_BOOKING * _global_booking_rate) / (_fold_agg["count"] + K_BOOKING)
    _fold_map = _fold_agg["rate"].to_dict()
    _oof_rate[_val_idx] = pd.Series(_nbhd_arr[_val_idx]).map(_fold_map).fillna(_global_booking_rate).values

# full-training smoothed rate - used for test and for nbhd_listing_count
_nbhd_booking_agg = (
    train_clean
    .with_columns(pl.col("high_booking").cast(pl.Utf8).cast(pl.Int32).alias("_hb_int"))
    .group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed")
    .agg([
        pl.col("_hb_int").sum().alias("nbhd_hb_sum"),
        pl.col("_hb_int").count().alias("nbhd_n"),
    ])
    .with_columns([
        ((pl.col("nbhd_hb_sum") + K_BOOKING * _global_booking_rate)
         / (pl.col("nbhd_n") + K_BOOKING))
        .alias("nbhd_booking_rate"),
        pl.col("nbhd_n").alias("nbhd_listing_count"),
    ])
)
_nbhd_booking_map = dict(zip(
    _nbhd_booking_agg["neighbourhood_cleansed"].to_list(),
    _nbhd_booking_agg["nbhd_booking_rate"].to_list()
))
_nbhd_count_map = dict(zip(
    _nbhd_booking_agg["neighbourhood_cleansed"].to_list(),
    _nbhd_booking_agg["nbhd_listing_count"].to_list()
))

train_clean = train_clean.with_columns([
    pl.Series("nbhd_booking_rate", _oof_rate),
    pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
      .replace_strict(_nbhd_count_map, default=0)
      .cast(pl.Float64).alias("nbhd_listing_count"),
])
test_clean = test_clean.with_columns([
    pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
      .replace_strict(_nbhd_booking_map, default=_global_booking_rate)
      .cast(pl.Float64).alias("nbhd_booking_rate"),
    pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
      .replace_strict(_nbhd_count_map, default=0)
      .cast(pl.Float64).alias("nbhd_listing_count"),
])

def pricing_signals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        (pl.col("price") + pl.col("cleaning_fee").fill_null(0) + pl.col("security_deposit").fill_null(0))
            .alias("total_cost"),
        (pl.col("cleaning_fee").fill_null(0) / pl.col("price").clip(lower_bound=1))
            .alias("cleaning_fee_ratio"),
        # price relative to neighbourhood median (computed from train only)
        # unseen test neighbourhoods fall back to global training median
        (pl.col("price") / pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
            .replace_strict(_nbhd_median, default=None)
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .fill_null(_global_median_price))
            .alias("price_vs_neighbourhood_median"),
        (pl.col("price") / pl.col("bedrooms").fill_null(1).clip(lower_bound=1))
            .alias("price_per_bedroom"),
        (pl.col("cleaning_fee").fill_null(0) / pl.col("minimum_nights").clip(lower_bound=1))
            .alias("cleaning_fee_per_night"),
    ])

train_clean = pricing_signals(train_clean)
test_clean  = pricing_signals(test_clean)

def pricing_strategy(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        # ratio < 1.0 = host discounts for longer stays (motivated to fill calendar)
        # null = host hasn't set weekly/monthly pricing at all
        (pl.col("weekly_price") / 7.0 / pl.col("price").clip(lower_bound=1))
            .alias("weekly_rate_ratio"),
        (pl.col("monthly_price") / 30.0 / pl.col("price").clip(lower_bound=1))
            .alias("monthly_rate_ratio"),
        pl.col("weekly_price").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_weekly_pricing"),
        pl.col("monthly_price").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_monthly_pricing"),
    ])

train_clean = pricing_strategy(train_clean)
test_clean  = pricing_strategy(test_clean)

## -- Cardinality check -- ##
nbhd_counts = (
    train_clean
    .group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed")
    .agg(pl.col("price").count().alias("n"))
    .sort("n", descending=False)  # sparse ones first
)
print(nbhd_counts)

train_nbhds = set(train_clean["neighbourhood_cleansed"].unique().to_list())
test_nbhds  = set(test_clean["neighbourhood_cleansed"].unique().to_list())

print(f"Train unique neighbourhoods: {len(train_nbhds)}")
print(f"Test unique neighbourhoods:  {len(test_nbhds)}")
print(f"In test but NOT in train:    {len(test_nbhds - train_nbhds)}")  # will hit your fallback
print(f"In train but NOT in test:    {len(train_nbhds - test_nbhds)}")  # wasted aggregates

# How many of the 993 test neighbourhoods have thin train coverage?
nbhd_counts = (
    train_clean
    .group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed")
    .agg(pl.col("price").count().alias("n"))
    .with_columns(pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8))
)
test_nbhds_df = pl.DataFrame({"neighbourhood_cleansed": list(test_nbhds)})
test_nbhds_coverage = test_nbhds_df.join(nbhd_counts, on="neighbourhood_cleansed", how="left").sort("n")
test_nbhds_coverage

thresholds = [10, 30, 50]
for t in thresholds:
    below = test_nbhds_coverage.filter(
        pl.col("n").is_null() | (pl.col("n") < t)
    ).height
    print(f"< {t} rows (or unseen): {below} / 993 test neighbourhoods ({below/993*100:.1f}%)")
```

```{python listing-options}
def count_photos(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        # log-scaled listing ID - lower = older/more established listing (compressed to prevent memorization)
        pl.col("listing_url")
            .str.extract(r"/rooms/(\d+)", 1)
            .cast(pl.Float64)
            .log(base=10)
            .alias("listing_id_proxy"),
        pl.col("picture_url").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_photo"),
        # _original in filename = older photo upload style
        pl.col("picture_url")
            .str.contains(r"_original")
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("listing_photo_has_original"),
        # URL generation as categorical - encodes listing era without using quasi-unique IDs
        # priority order matters: check most specific patterns first
        pl.when(pl.col("picture_url").is_null())
            .then(pl.lit("null"))
        .when(pl.col("picture_url").str.contains(r"miso/Hosting-"))
            .then(pl.lit("miso"))
        .when(pl.col("picture_url").str.contains(r"/ic/pictures/"))
            .then(pl.lit("ic_legacy"))
        .when(pl.col("picture_url").str.contains(r"/im/pictures/\d+/"))
            .then(pl.lit("old_numeric"))
        .when(pl.col("picture_url").str.contains(r"/im/pictures/"))
            .then(pl.lit("old_uuid"))
        .when(pl.col("picture_url").str.contains(r"/pictures/"))
            .then(pl.lit("new_plain"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("old_uuid"))
        .cast(pl.Categorical)
        .alias("picture_url_format"),
    ])

train_clean = count_photos(train_clean)
test_clean = count_photos(test_clean)
```

```{python dynamic-pricing-features}
def add_dynamic_pricing(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    price = pl.col("price")

    weekly_discount_pct = (
        pl.when(pl.col("weekly_price").is_not_null() & (price > 0) &
                (pl.col("weekly_price") < price * 7))
            .then((price * 7 - pl.col("weekly_price")) / (price * 7) * 100)
            .otherwise(0.0)
    )

    monthly_discount_pct = (
        pl.when(pl.col("monthly_price").is_not_null() & (price > 0) &
                (pl.col("monthly_price") < price * 30))
            .then((price * 30 - pl.col("monthly_price")) / (price * 30) * 100)
            .otherwise(0.0)
    )

    # absolute price tier - budget/mid/premium/luxury
    price_tier = (
        pl.when(price < 50).then(pl.lit("budget"))
          .when(price < 100).then(pl.lit("mid"))
          .when(price < 200).then(pl.lit("premium"))
          .otherwise(pl.lit("luxury"))
          .cast(pl.Categorical)
    )

    # cleaning fee as fraction of nightly price - high ratio = anchoring strategy
    cleaning_fee_ratio = (
        pl.when(pl.col("cleaning_fee").is_not_null() & (price > 0))
            .then(pl.col("cleaning_fee") / price)
            .otherwise(0.0)
    )

    return df.with_columns([
        weekly_discount_pct.alias("weekly_discount_pct"),
        monthly_discount_pct.alias("monthly_discount_pct"),
        price_tier.alias("price_tier"),
        cleaning_fee_ratio.alias("cleaning_fee_ratio"),
    ])

train_clean = add_dynamic_pricing(train_clean)
test_clean  = add_dynamic_pricing(test_clean)
```

```{python description-amenity-features}
_DESC_LUXURY_KW   = [r"rooftop", r"jacuzzi", r"hot tub", r"\bpool\b", r"panoramic",
                     r"ocean.?view", r"mountain.?view", r"waterfront", r"penthouse",
                     r"infinity pool", r"private terrace", r"wine cellar", r"sauna"]
_DESC_LOCATION_KW = [r"\bbeach\b", r"beachfront", r"lakefront", r"lake view",
                     r"city view", r"park view", r"walking distance", r"steps from"]
_DESC_AMENITY_KW  = [r"free parking", r"parking included", r"garage", r"ev charger",
                     r"coffee maker", r"espresso", r"record player", r"board games"]

def add_description_amenities(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    desc = pl.col("description").fill_null("").str.to_lowercase()
    name = pl.col("name").fill_null("").str.to_lowercase()
    combined = (pl.col("description").fill_null("") + " " + pl.col("name").fill_null("")).str.to_lowercase()

    desc_luxury = reduce(lambda a, b: a + b,
                         [desc.str.contains(kw).cast(pl.Int32) for kw in _DESC_LUXURY_KW])
    desc_location = reduce(lambda a, b: a + b,
                           [desc.str.contains(kw).cast(pl.Int32) for kw in _DESC_LOCATION_KW])
    desc_amenity = reduce(lambda a, b: a + b,
                          [desc.str.contains(kw).cast(pl.Int32) for kw in _DESC_AMENITY_KW])

    # luxury signal combining both amenities field and description
    name_luxury = name.str.contains(
        r"rooftop|luxury|penthouse|ocean.?view|beach|resort|panoramic|infinity|designer"
    ).cast(pl.Int32)

    return df.with_columns([
        desc_luxury.alias("desc_luxury_count"),
        desc_location.alias("desc_location_count"),
        desc_amenity.alias("desc_bonus_amenity_count"),
        name_luxury.alias("has_luxury_name_keyword"),
    ])

train_clean = add_description_amenities(train_clean)
test_clean  = add_description_amenities(test_clean)
```

```{python imputation-check-typing}
# price cap at 99th percentile
price_cap = train_clean["price"].quantile(0.99)
train_clean = train_clean.filter((pl.col("price") > 0) & (pl.col("price") <= price_cap))
test_clean = test_clean.with_columns([
    pl.col("price").clip(lower_bound=1, upper_bound=price_cap),
    (pl.col("price").clip(lower_bound=1, upper_bound=price_cap) / pl.col("accommodates").cast(pl.Float64).clip(lower_bound=1))
```

```{python neighbourhood-signals}
# all three aggregates computed from train only - applied to both train and test
_nbhd_rpm_agg    = train_clean.group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed").agg(pl.col("reviews_per_month").median())
_nbhd_rpm        = dict(zip(_nbhd_rpm_agg["neighbourhood_cleansed"].to_list(), _nbhd_rpm_agg["reviews_per_month"].to_list()))
_global_rpm      = float(train_clean["reviews_per_month"].median())

_nbhd_rating_agg = train_clean.group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed").agg(pl.col("review_scores_rating").median())
_nbhd_rating     = dict(zip(_nbhd_rating_agg["neighbourhood_cleansed"].to_list(), _nbhd_rating_agg["review_scores_rating"].to_list()))
_global_rating   = float(train_clean["review_scores_rating"].median())

_nbhd_price_agg  = train_clean.group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed").agg(pl.col("price").median())
_nbhd_price      = dict(zip(_nbhd_price_agg["neighbourhood_cleansed"].to_list(), _nbhd_price_agg["price"].to_list()))
_global_nbhd_price = float(train_clean["price"].median())

_nbhd_acc_agg    = train_clean.group_by("neighbourhood_cleansed").agg(pl.col("accommodates").median())
_nbhd_acc        = dict(zip(_nbhd_acc_agg["neighbourhood_cleansed"].to_list(), _nbhd_acc_agg["accommodates"].to_list()))
_global_nbhd_acc = float(train_clean["accommodates"].median())

def neighbourhood_signals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
            .replace_strict(_nbhd_rpm, default=None).cast(pl.Float64).fill_null(_global_rpm)
            .alias("nbhd_median_reviews_per_month"),
        pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
            .replace_strict(_nbhd_rating, default=None).cast(pl.Float64).fill_null(_global_rating)
            .alias("nbhd_median_review_score"),
        pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
            .replace_strict(_nbhd_price, default=None).cast(pl.Float64).fill_null(_global_nbhd_price)
            .alias("nbhd_median_price"),
        pl.col("neighbourhood_cleansed").cast(pl.Utf8)
            .replace_strict(_nbhd_acc, default=None).cast(pl.Float64).fill_null(_global_nbhd_acc)
            .alias("nbhd_median_accommodates"),
    ])

train_clean = neighbourhood_signals(train_clean)
test_clean  = neighbourhood_signals(test_clean)
```

```{python host-trust-signals}
def host_trust_signals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        # null means not verified - treat as FALSE
        pl.col("host_identity_verified")
            .cast(pl.Utf8)
            .str.to_lowercase()
            .str.contains("true")
            .fill_null(False)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("host_identity_verified"),
        # null means market doesn't require it - treat as FALSE
        pl.col("requires_license")
            .cast(pl.Utf8)
            .str.to_lowercase()
            .str.contains("true")
            .fill_null(False)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("requires_license"),
    ])
```

```{python host-verification-signals}
def host_verification_signals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.with_columns([
        # total number of verifications - proxy for trust tier
        pl.col("host_verifications")
            .str.count_matches(r"'[^']+'")
            .fill_null(0)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("verification_count"),
        # platform has confirmed host has prior reviews - social proof
        pl.col("host_verifications")
            .str.contains("'reviews'")
            .fill_null(False)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("has_reviews_verification"),
        # government_id catches both government_id and offline_government_id
        pl.col("host_verifications")
            .str.contains("government_id")
            .fill_null(False)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("has_id_verification"),
    ])

train_clean = host_verification_signals(train_clean)
test_clean  = host_verification_signals(test_clean)
```

```{python text-effort-signals}
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.col("summary").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_summary"),
        pl.col("summary").fill_null("").str.len_chars().cast(pl.Float64).alias("summary_length"),
        pl.col("neighborhood_overview").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_neighborhood_overview"),

        pl.col("house_rules").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_house_rules"),
        pl.col("transit").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_transit_info"),
        # shared bath = fundamentally different guest experience vs private/standard bath
        pl.col("bathrooms_text")
            .str.contains("shared")
            .fill_null(False)
            .cast(pl.Int32)
            .alias("has_shared_bath"),
        pl.col("name").fill_null("").str.len_chars().cast(pl.Float64).alias("name_length"),
        pl.col("house_rules").fill_null("").str.len_chars().cast(pl.Float64).alias("house_rules_length"),
    ])
```

```{python license-signals}
def license_signals(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    lic = pl.col("license").cast(pl.Utf8).str.to_lowercase()
    return df.with_columns([
        pl.col("license").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_license"),
        lic.str.contains("pending").fill_null(False).cast(pl.Int32).alias("license_is_pending"),
        lic.str.contains("exempt").fill_null(False).cast(pl.Int32).alias("license_is_exempt"),
        # registered = has a real license number, not pending and not exempt
        (
            pl.col("license").is_not_null() &
            ~lic.str.contains("pending") &
            ~lic.str.contains("exempt")
        ).cast(pl.Int32).alias("license_is_registered"),
    ])
```

```{python conversion-rate-features}
def add_conversion_features(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # listing completeness score: count of non-null text sections (0–9)
    _text_cols = ["name", "summary", "description", "space", "neighborhood_overview",
                  "transit", "access", "interaction", "house_rules"]
    completeness = reduce(
        lambda a, b: a + b,
        [pl.col(c).is_not_null().cast(pl.Int32) for c in _text_cols]
    )

    # security deposit signals
    has_deposit = (pl.col("security_deposit").is_not_null() & (pl.col("security_deposit") > 0))
    deposit_per_night = (
        pl.when(has_deposit & (pl.col("price") > 0))
            .then(pl.col("security_deposit") / pl.col("price"))
            .otherwise(0.0)
    )

    # discount flags - replace the broken monthly_rate_ratio (343k nulls)
    has_weekly_discount = (
        pl.col("weekly_price").is_not_null() &
        (pl.col("price") > 0) &
        (pl.col("weekly_price") < pl.col("price") * 7)
    ).cast(pl.Int32)

    has_monthly_discount = (
        pl.col("monthly_price").is_not_null() &
        (pl.col("price") > 0) &
        (pl.col("monthly_price") < pl.col("price") * 30)
    ).cast(pl.Int32)

    # generosity of base price before extra-person charges kick in
    guests_included_ratio = (
        pl.when(pl.col("accommodates") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("guests_included").cast(pl.Float64) / pl.col("accommodates"))
            .otherwise(0.0)
    )

    # booking friction and market-segment signals
    def _bool_flag(col: str) -> pl.Expr:
        return (
            pl.col(col).fill_null("f").cast(pl.Utf8).str.to_lowercase()
              .str.contains("t").cast(pl.Int32).alias(col)
        )

    return df.with_columns([
        completeness.alias("listing_completeness_score"),
        has_deposit.cast(pl.Int32).alias("has_security_deposit"),
        deposit_per_night.alias("security_deposit_per_night"),
        has_weekly_discount.alias("has_weekly_discount"),
        has_monthly_discount.alias("has_monthly_discount"),
        guests_included_ratio.alias("guests_included_ratio"),
        _bool_flag("require_guest_profile_picture"),
        _bool_flag("require_guest_phone_verification"),
        _bool_flag("is_business_travel_ready"),
    ])

train_clean = add_conversion_features(train_clean)
test_clean  = add_conversion_features(test_clean)
```

```{python build-text-svd-helper}
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD

def build_text_svd_features(
    train_text, valid_text, test_text,
    max_features=5000, n_components=50,
    ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=5, random_state=42,
):
    tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=max_features,
        ngram_range=ngram_range,
        min_df=min_df,
        sublinear_tf=True,
    )
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=n_components, random_state=random_state)

    tr_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(pd.Series(train_text).fillna(""))
    va_tfidf = tfidf.transform(pd.Series(valid_text).fillna(""))
    te_tfidf = tfidf.transform(pd.Series(test_text).fillna(""))

    tr_svd = svd.fit_transform(tr_tfidf)
    va_svd = svd.transform(va_tfidf)
    te_svd = svd.transform(te_tfidf)

    print(f"  SVD variance explained: {svd.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.3f}")
    return tr_svd, va_svd, te_svd
```

```{python oof-cv-catboost}
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import catboost as cb
import numpy as np

N_SVD = 40
_svd_cols = [f"desc_svd_{i}" for i in range(N_SVD)]

best_params = {
    "learning_rate":    0.02,
    "depth":            10,
    "l2_leaf_reg":      35,
    "subsample":        0.7471070912992345,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 226,
    "rsm":              0.6176715042998242,
    "random_strength":  0.80,
}

final_params = {
    "loss_function":      "Logloss",
    "eval_metric":        "AUC",
    "auto_class_weights": "Balanced",
    "iterations":         2000,
    "od_wait":            25,
    "logging_level":      "Silent",
    "random_seed":        42,
    **best_params,
}

n_train = len(X_tab)
n_test  = len(X_test_tab)
n_folds = 5

oof_pred        = np.zeros(n_train, dtype=float)
test_pred_folds = np.zeros((n_folds, n_test), dtype=float)
best_iterations = []

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# only do 1 fold

for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(list(skf.split(X_tab, y))[:1], start=1):
    print(f"Fold {fold}/1...")

    X_tr_tab = X_tab.iloc[tr_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
    X_va_tab = X_tab.iloc[va_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
    y_tr, y_va = y[tr_idx], y[va_idx]

    tr_text = [train_text_raw[i] for i in tr_idx]
    va_text = [train_text_raw[i] for i in va_idx]

    tr_svd, va_svd, te_svd = build_text_svd_features(tr_text, va_text, test_text_raw,
                                                       n_components=N_SVD)

    X_tr = pd.concat([
        X_tr_tab.reset_index(drop=True),
        pd.DataFrame(tr_svd, columns=_svd_cols),
    ], axis=1)
    X_va = pd.concat([
        X_va_tab.reset_index(drop=True),
        pd.DataFrame(va_svd, columns=_svd_cols),
    ], axis=1)
    X_te = pd.concat([
        X_test_tab.reset_index(drop=True),
        pd.DataFrame(te_svd, columns=_svd_cols),
    ], axis=1)

    tr_pool = cb.Pool(X_tr, label=y_tr, cat_features=cat_features)
    va_pool = cb.Pool(X_va, label=y_va, cat_features=cat_features)
    te_pool = cb.Pool(X_te,              cat_features=cat_features)

    model = cb.CatBoostClassifier(**final_params)
    model.fit(tr_pool, eval_set=va_pool, use_best_model=True)

    oof_pred[va_idx] = model.predict_proba(va_pool)[:, 1]
    test_pred_folds[fold - 1] = model.predict_proba(te_pool)[:, 1]
    best_iterations.append(model.best_iteration_)

    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_va, oof_pred[va_idx])
    print(f"  Fold {fold} AUC: {fold_auc:.5f} | best_iteration: {model.best_iteration_}")

cv_auc   = roc_auc_score(y, oof_pred)
test_pred = test_pred_folds[:fold].mean(axis=0)  # only average completed folds
mean_iter = int(np.mean(best_iterations))

print(f"\nOOF CV AUC: {cv_auc:.5f}")
print(f"Mean best iteration: {mean_iter}")
```
